gen.title: How fault properties control seismic moment
gen.formulaText: Moment (MO) = rigidity x area x slip
gen.quote: Moment (MO) = rigidity x area x slip

variables.name: rigidity
variables.quote: where rigidity is the strength of the rock along the fault, area is the area of the fault that slipped, and slip is the distance the fault moved.

sourceExample.quote: If the San Andreas Fault were to rupture end-to-end (~1400km), with ~10m of average slip, it would produce an earthquake of Mw 8.47.
